description.value: Boston Pizza Tsawwassen is a franchise location of Canada's largest casual dining chain, situated in the Tsawwassen area of Delta near the Tsawwassen Mills shopping development. The restaurant combines a full sit-down dining room with a sports bar atmosphere, offering a broad menu of pizzas, pastas, wings, and more. Cyclists on the Canoe Pass Way corridor will find it a convenient full-service meal stop with dietary accommodations including gluten-free and vegetarian options.

address.value: 3 - 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, BC, V4M 0B3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the location is open and operating at 3 - 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, with the phone number matching OSM. The website and OSM tags both support vegetarian, vegan (limited), and gluten-free (GlutenWise®) options, and the prominent 'ORDER NOW' functionality confirms takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '5000 Canoe Pass Way, Delta, V4E 0B3' but website shows unit '3 - 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, BC, V4M 0B3'. Unit number, municipality label (Delta vs Tsawwassen), and postal code (V4E vs V4M) all differ — address should be verified on-ground.
No bike parking information available from website or OSM tags; this is a required criterion for WWC listing and should be confirmed via site visit or local knowledge.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service restaurant with takeout and dietary options (vegetarian, vegan, GF) at a commercial node on Canoe Pass Way; useful as a meal stop for cyclists on the Tsawwassen routes, pending confirmation of bike parking.
